items.description: One probes row: a registered probe kind reading a declared SOCKET set at a bounded rate, and the bindings that route its channels. A socket is a named input slot the kind's manifest declares (e.g. color, strobe); a row plugs one WorldFrameSource into each socket name it binds. Exactly one of Inputs/Track is present — the live-hardware leg (named sockets) or the recorded-track leg (one puck.probe-track.v1 document standing in for every socket at once), never both, never neither. A world declares no probes rows when it wants no camera-derived reading at all. Boot-authored only: no WorldSection dispatch axis carries a live mutation kind for it yet (see Probes), the same standing judges carries.

id.description: The probe's own name — WorldSafeName-shaped, unique among the rows; probe.status and probe.record address it.

kind.description: The registered probe kind id (a puck.probe.v1 manifest's file stem) — checked against the shipped vocabulary at document load (IsRegisteredProbeKind), never interpreted here. The document never states where the kind runs; the kind's own registration decides kernel-on-device versus out-of-process model.

rateHz.description: The probe's cadence ceiling, 1..240 Hz — a rate its host may run slower than (latest-wins throughout the pipeline), never faster.

inputs.description: The kind's sockets, by name, each bound to the frame source that fills it — the live-hardware leg. The socket vocabulary itself lives behind the kind's manifest, unchecked here; the host checks a bound name against it by name at boot, the same shallow-then-deep split every kind-vocabulary field follows. Mutually exclusive with Track. Omitted from the wire when null.

track.description: A recorded puck.probe-track.v1 document path, resolved against the world document's own directory, played back in place of every socket at once — probe.record's own output shape, the hardware-free leg every probe admits. Mutually exclusive with Inputs. Omitted from the wire when null.

config.description: The kind's config values, or null when the kind declares none or every field has a default. Not validated at document load — the kind's own manifest config schema validates it at boot, matching Config's shallow-then-deep precedent.

bindings.description: What this probe's channels drive, or null for a probe that is only read back.

items.description: One probes[].bindings row: routes one of the enclosing probe's channels to a command axis, a presentation parameter, or a camera control. The $type string is the JSON discriminator.

anyOf.description: Conditions a channel into a per-tick command axis, sampled through Puck.Commands exactly like a stick axis: deadband with hysteresis, optional fixed-point EMA, quantization, and a declared MaxAgeSeconds after which the axis returns to neutral and confidence to zero.

channel.description: The probe channel name — checked against the kind's manifest at boot, never here.

source.description: The axis' own name — kebab-case, 1..64 characters, unique among every probe's axis bindings. Publishes the input source id probe.<Source> (Puck.Input.InputSources.Probe.Axis), an ordinary bindable Axis1D source any binding overlay may map like a stick.

deadband.description: The deadband about the channel's neutral, in [0, 1) of the mapped [-1, 1] axis range.

hysteresis.description: The hysteresis band width, in [0, 1), applied at the deadband edge.

smoothing.description: The fixed-point EMA smoothing factor, in [0, 1] — 0 disables smoothing.

maxAgeSeconds.description: How long a reading stays live before the axis returns to neutral and confidence to zero. Must be finite and positive.

seat.description: The 1-based local seat this axis is captured for.

anyOf.description: Writes a channel into a presentation-float shader-extension config field, lerped over Range. Presentation-only — the destination never feeds simulation state.

channel.description: The probe channel name — checked against the kind's manifest at boot, never here.

anyOf.description: Writes a shader-extension config field on a composed render.extensions entry.

id.description: The render.extensions[].id entry this targets — must name an entry the document itself composes.

field.description: The extension's config field name — checked against its manifest at boot, never here (the same shallow-then-deep precedent every kind-vocabulary field follows).

anyOf.description: Writes a config field of another declared probe's kind, live, into its running kernel — one probe's reading steering another's computation (a tracked centroid placing a relighting kind's light).

id.description: The probes[].id this targets — a row of this document other than the binding's own.

field.description: That probe's kind config field name — checked against its manifest at boot, never here.

range.description: The [min, max] presentation range a channel's mapped [-1, 1] axis value lerps across. Must be finite with X < Y.

maxAgeSeconds.description: How long a reading stays live before this binding stops writing. Must be finite and positive.

anyOf.description: Writes a channel onto the existing WorldCameraControls surface, mapped over [Minimum, Maximum].

channel.description: The probe channel name — checked against the kind's manifest at boot, never here.

control.description: The WorldCameraControls member this binding writes — one of pan, tilt, zoom, exposure, focus, brightness, contrast, saturation, sharpness, gain, whiteBalance, backlightCompensation, or fieldOfView.

minimum.description: The control value a channel's mapped -1 resolves to.

maximum.description: The control value a channel's mapped 1 resolves to. Must exceed Minimum.

maxAgeSeconds.description: How long a reading stays live before this binding stops writing. Must be finite and positive.
